---
title: "Evidence map and writing protocol"
aliases:
  - "/explorations/warming-acceleration/manuscript/00-evidence-map.html"
---

This page is the audit boundary for the formal manuscript. It records where a
manuscript statement gets its support; it does not duplicate figures, numerical
results, or literature extracts.

> 本页是正式手稿的证据边界：记录每类论断应由哪里支持，不重复图件、数值结果或文献摘录。

## Evidence route

1. Exact source conditions, quotations, and reusable claims remain in
   [Paper notes](../../../notes/papers/index.md).
2. The reason a source matters to this question, including its local role and
   reading question, remains in the exploration [Literature map](../literature/index.qmd).
3. Reproducible analytical detail, sensitivity checks, and negative results
   remain in the formal [Results](results/01-global-kinematics.qmd) and
   [Investigations](../investigations/local-rate-change-sensitivity.qmd).
4. This manuscript contains only the retained argument and links back when a
   reader needs the condition, robustness evidence, or source record.

> 证据路径分四层：论文笔记保存来源条件、摘录和可复用论点；Literature map 说明它为何与本研究相关；Draft 与 Investigations 保存可重复的分析、敏感性和负结果；Manuscript 只保留已收敛的论证，并回链到相应证据。

## Chapter evidence boundary

- [Introduction](01-introduction.qmd): every external factual or novelty claim
  must have a citation and a corresponding reviewed paper note. Comparator
  scope is maintained in [Novelty and comparators](../literature/novelty-and-comparators.qmd).
- [Methods](02-methods.qmd): definitions must agree with the
  [analysis contract](../../../docs/analysis-contract.qmd). Method alternatives
  and historical exclusions belong in [Method audit](../literature/method-audit.qmd)
  or Investigations, not in the main method narrative.
- [Results](results/index.md): retained figures and numerical statements must
  link to their active draft provenance. Seasonal and ice material remains
  modular unless it independently supports the central claim.
- [Discussion](04-discussion.qmd): interpretation may use reviewed mechanism
  evidence, but must respect the boundary in
  [Mechanisms and boundaries](../literature/mechanisms.qmd). No descriptive
  association is promoted to causal attribution.

> 各章边界：Introduction 的外部事实与新意论断要有引文和已审阅笔记；Methods 必须与 analysis contract 一致，替代方法放入审查层；Results 只保留有 draft 溯源的图与数值；Discussion 可使用已审阅的机制证据，但不得把描述关联提升为因果归因。

## Writing gate

Before a paragraph becomes manuscript prose, confirm four things: its claim is
within the study scope; its supporting result is retained; any external claim
has a reviewed source record; and its wording does not exceed the relevant
method or association boundary. A missing item is an evidence task, not a
reason to strengthen the prose.

> 一段文字进入手稿前，确认四件事：论断在研究范围内；支持它的结果已保留；外部事实有已审阅来源；措辞不越过方法或关联边界。缺少其中一项时，应建立证据任务，而不是增强语气。
